title: Root /health route is not covered by a regression test
reasoning: The route is explicitly used for Docker healthcheck and backwards compatibility, but the feature lists no linked tests. Existing health tests found in the repository exercise /api/health, not the root /health endpoint, so removing this route or changing its response contract could pass the current health test coverage.
recommendation: Add a focused TestClient regression test for GET /health that asserts HTTP 200 and the expected JSON body.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The feature metadata has an empty tests list, and the existing health test file only requests /api/health and /api/health/config.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add test_root_health in tests/test_health.py: client.get("/health") should return 200 with {"status": "healthy"}.
minimumFixScope: Test-only change covering the root_health route.
